title: Create an Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Search Ads Campaign for Web
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to create an Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Search Ads Campaign for Web. This campaign type dynamically leverages your E-commerce catalog products to populate and deliver targeted web ads. To configure this campaign type, set `catalog_enabled` to `true` and `catalog_type` to `ECOMMERCE` at the campaign level. By integrating E-commerce Catalog Ads, the system will automatically generate diverse ad creatives, including catalog videos, catalog carousels, and single videos. # Prerequisites Creating an E-commerce Search Ads Campaign for Web requires setting up an E-commerce catalog in your Business Center first. To set up the catalog: 1. Create an **E-commerce** catalog using [/catalog/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-catalog/v1.3). 2. Upload products to the catalog using [/catalog/product/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-products-via-a-json-schema/v1.3) (JSON schema), [/catalog/product/file/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-products-via-a-file-url/v1.3) (CSV feed template), or [/catalog/feed/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-feed/v1.3)(online data feed schedule). 3. Check the product handling results. - For CSV feed and JSON schema, use [/catalog/product/log/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-product-handling-log/v1.3). - Pass in the `feed_log_id` obtained from Step 2. If the field `error_affected_products` in the response is not null, examine the issue details and return to Step 2 to reupload the product. - For online feed, use [/catalog/feed/log/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-log-of-a-feed/v1.3). - Pass in the `feed_id` obtained from Step 2. If the field `error_count` in the response is not 0, examine your online feed and return to Step 2 to reupload the product. 4. (Optional) Create an E-commerce product set using [/catalog/set/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-product-set-by-conditions/v1.3). If you want to have products selected from a product set, creating a product set is necessary. Otherwise, you can skip this step. 5. (Optional) Invite members to Business Center and grant the admin permission using [/bc/member/invite/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/invite-members-to-a-bc/v1.3). You can also choose `advertiser_role` that you want to assign to the members invited. 6. (Optional) Share a catalog with members and grant catalog management access using [/bc/asset/assign/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/assign-an-asset/v1.3). Make sure to specify `CATALOG` in the `asset_type` field and `ADMIN` in the `catalog_role` field. # Steps ## 1. Create a campaign Create a campaign using [/smart_plus/campaign/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-an-upgraded-smart-campaign/v1.3). Note that the following requirements must be met. To find a complete list of parameters, see [/smart_plus/campaign/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-an-upgraded-smart-campaign/v1.3).

### Customize the ad format combinations in Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Search Ads Campaigns for Web If you enable auto-selection of catalog creatives (`catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`), the system will automatically create ads using combinations of three possible formats: catalog carousel, catalog video, single video, and image carousel. The possible ad format combinations for your E-commerce Search Ads Campaigns for Web are illustrated in the following table. ```xtable |Is the catalog carousel format available?{18%}|Is the catalog video format available?{15%}|Is the single video format available?{15%}|Is the image carousel format available?{18%}|Ad format combination for your E-commerce Search Ads Campaigns for Web{25%}| |---|---|---|---|---| |✅|❌|❌|❌|Catalog carousel only| |✅|❌|✅|❌|Catalog carousel and single video| |✅|❌|❌|✅|Catalog carousel and image carousel| |✅|✅|❌|❌|Catalog carousel and catalog video| |✅|✅|✅|❌|Catalog carousel, catalog video, and single video| |✅|✅|❌|✅|Catalog carousel, catalog video, and image carousel| |✅|❌|✅|✅|Catalog carousel, single video, and image carousel| |✅|✅|✅|✅|Catalog carousel, catalog video, single video, and image carousel| ``` To ensure certain ad formats are available in E-commerce Search Ads Campaigns for Web, follow the instructions in the following table.
Ad formatAd format descriptionHow to ensure the ad format is availableHow to configure the parameters
catalog carouselDisplay 2–20 products in a slideshow format. This format will showcase product images of up to 20 products from your catalog at a time.Enable "Image" in your catalog creative settings, allowing the system to use images from your catalogs in the ad.Ensure IMAGE is included in the catalog_media_settings value.
The catalog needs to contain at least two products supported in Catalog Carousel Ads.Ensure that the catalog (catalog_id) contains at least two approved products. You can verify this by checking the value of approved returned from /catalog/overview/, which should be at least two.
  • Carousel image selection scope: The product images for products in a catalog (catalog_id) will be dynamically chosen as images in the delivering Catalog Carousel Ads. The scope of product images to choose from is determined by the specified product_specific_type parameter:
    • If product_specific_type is set to ALL, the system will dynamically choose Carousel images from all products in the catalog.
    • If product_specific_type is set to PRODUCT_SET, the system will dynamically choose Carousel images from products in the specified product set (product_set_id).
    • If product_specific_type is set to CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS, the system will dynamically choose Carousel images from a customized product range consisting of up to 20 products (product_ids).
  • Carousel image type:
    • Use the main images of the products: By default, the main image URLs of the dynamically selected catalog products will be used as Carousel images.
Specify a piece of music supported in Catalog Carousel Ads.Pass one music ID that is valid for use in Catalog Carousel Ads via music_info.

Note: To obtain a valid music ID, you can use any of the following methods:

  • Filter the pieces of music for Catalog Carousel Ads under an ad account by specifying music_scene as CATALOG_CAROUSEL in /file/music/get/.
  • Upload a piece of customized music for Catalog Carousel Ads to an ad account by using any of the following methods:
    • Specify music_scene as CATALOG_CAROUSEL and pass music_file and music_signature in /file/music/upload/.
    • Specify music_scene as CATALOG_CAROUSEL, upload_type as UPLOAD_BY_FILE_ID, and pass file_id to /file/music/upload/.
catalog videoGenerate a dynamic video based on information from the product catalogEnable "Video templates" in your catalog creative settings, allowing the system to use video templates from your catalogs in the ad.Ensure TEMPLATE_VIDEO is included in the catalog_media_settings value.
The catalog must have at least one video template.
  • If you select a video template, the video template will be used to automatically generate the catalog video for each catalog product.
  • If you don't select the video template, the system will automatically select one of your video templates for each catalog product to generate the corresponding catalog video.
Ensure that at least one video template is bound to your catalog (catalog_id).
  • To ensure that at least one video template (video package) is bound to your catalog, use /catalog/video_package/get/.
    • To learn about how to create video templates on TikTok Ads Manager, see How to create video packages in a Catalog.
    • To retrieve video templates for your catalog via API, use /catalog/video_package/get/.

  • If catalog_template_video_id is specified, the specified video template will be used to automatically generate the catalog video for each catalog product.
  • If catalog_template_video_id is not specified, the system will automatically select one of your video templates for each catalog product to generate the corresponding catalog video. When a product has a video URL, that video will be used instead.
Use videos from your catalog to promote your products.Enable "Video" in your catalog creative settings, allowing the system to use videos from your catalogs in the ad.Ensure VIDEO is included in the catalog_media_settings value.
You need to configure a video URL for each catalog product.Ensure that a video URL (video_url) has been configured for each catalog product.
  • To ensure a video URL has been configured for each catalog product, use /catalog/product/get/ and check the returned video_url.
  • If you want to add video URLs for your catalog products, use /catalog/product/update/.
single videoUse specified video creatives to promote your products.Specify additional videos or TikTok video postsSpecify individual videos, video posts, or a combination of both.
  • For Spark Ads created by pulling existing TikTok posts from the TikTok account, specify additional TikTok video posts via tiktok_item_id.
  • For Spark Ads created by pushing videos to the TikTok account, specify additional videos via video_info and cover images via image_info, and one to five ad texts (ad_text_list).
image carouselUse specified carousel creatives to promote your products.Specify additional carousels or TikTok photo postsSpecify individual carousels, photo posts, or a combination of both.
  • For Spark Ads created by pulling existing TikTok posts from the TikTok account, specify additional TikTok photo posts via tiktok_item_id.
  • For Spark Ads created by pushing carousels to the TikTok account, specify one to 35 image IDs via image_info and one valid music ID via music_id, and one to five ad texts (ad_text_list) in each carousel.
    • To get image IDs, use /file/image/ad/upload/ or /file/image/ad/search/.
      • The image to be used in Carousel Ads should meet the requirements below at the same time:
        • Specifications:
          • File Type: JPG, JPEG, or PNG.
          • Image Resolution: a maximum of 1242 x 2340 pixels or 2340 x 1242 pixels.
          • Aspect Ratio: a maximum of 9:20 or 20:9.
          • File Size: below 50 MB.
        • The value of the parameter is_carousel_usable returned from /file/image/ad/search/ for the image is true.
    • To obtain a valid music ID, use any of the following methods:
      • Filter the pieces of music for Carousel Ads under an ad account by specifying music_scene as CAROUSEL_ADS in /file/music/get/.
      • Upload a piece of customized music for Carousel Ads to an ad account by any of the following methods:
        • Specifying music_scene as CAROUSEL_ADS and passing music_file and music_signature in /file/music/upload/
        • Specifying music_scene as CAROUSEL_ADS , specifying upload_type as UPLOAD_BY_FILE_ID, and passing file_id in /file/music/upload/.
